name: io.github.komakeule57-maker/frugal-memory
title: frugal-memory
description: Memory for AI assistants in one SQLite file: full-text search, no vectors, no embeddings.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORY_LANG
environmentVariables.description: Tool names, texts and stemmer: 'en' (default for a new memory) or 'de'. Unset, an existing memory keeps the language it was built in.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORY_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path of the SQLite file. Default: $XDG_DATA_HOME/frugal-memory/memory.db
